overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Infrastructure 2x Daily ETF (XPAV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund seeks daily investment results corresponding to 2x the daily performance of the Global X U.S. Infrastructure Development ETF XPAV was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
